messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- The catalog service still relies on the resizer. [valid 2026-05-27 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-05-27]
- The product catalog calls the image resizer for thumbnails, so the image resizer is a hard dependency of the product catalog. [valid 2025-04-14 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-04-14]
- As of 2026-03-17, storage for the image resizer's original uploads has doubled in six months. [valid 2026-03-17 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-03-17]
- On 2026-03-17, the Atlas team decided that the image resizer will keep original uploads for 90 days only, because storage for originals doubled in six months. [decision; valid 2026-03-17 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-03-17]
- The Atlas team owns the image resizer as of 2025-11-26, when ownership transferred from the Ember team. [decision; valid 2025-11-26 to now; recorded by handover/2025-11-26-image-resizer]
    earlier: The Ember team owns the image resizer as of 2025-03-20. [decision; valid 2025-03-20 to 2025-11-26; recorded by handover/2025-03-20-image-resizer]
    earlier: The Dune team owns the image resizer. [valid 2025-01-20 to 2025-03-20; recorded by standup/dune/2025-01-20]
- On 2025-10-15, the Atlas team noticed that the image resizer's queue depth hit 50,000 after the marketing send and pinged the owners. [valid 2025-10-15 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-10-15]
- As of the 2025-11-26 handover, the image resizer's dashboards and alerts are being repointed. [valid 2025-11-26 to now; recorded by handover/2025-11-26-image-resizer]
- On 2026-03-20, the Boreal team observed that the catalog service's disk usage jumped 30 percent after the retention change. [valid 2026-03-20 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-03-20-2]
- On 2026-06-04, the Boreal team observed that the catalog service's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-06-04 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-06-04]
- The Dune team observed on 2025-08-19 that the resizer's cold start time tripled after the runtime upgrade. [valid 2025-08-19 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-08-19-2]
- The product catalog will keep image metadata in a separate table, because the joined writes were locking product updates for seconds at a time. [decision; valid 2025-04-17 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-04-17]
- The indexer depends on the product catalog for product documents. [valid 2025-01-30 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-01-30]
- On 2026-06-09, the Dune team observed that the indexer's disk usage jumped 30 percent after the retention change. [valid 2026-06-09 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-06-09]
- On 2026-02-16, the Dune team observed that the product catalog's request volume halved after the client rollout and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-02-16 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-02-16]
- On 2025-12-18, the Atlas team decided that the indexer will rebuild the index nightly instead of on every catalog write, because incremental updates left stale entries behind after failed writes. [decision; valid 2025-12-18 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-12-18]
- The Boreal team observed on 2025-12-01 that the billing API's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump. [valid 2025-12-01 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-12-01]
- On 2026-04-16, the Atlas team observed that the ledger service's disk usage jumped 30 percent following the retention change, and since it was not their service, they flagged it. [valid 2026-04-16 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-04-16]
- On 2025-12-25, the Atlas team observed that the reports pipeline's disk usage jumped 30 percent following the retention change, and since it was not their service, they flagged it. [valid 2025-12-25 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-12-25]
- On 2025-12-19, the Atlas team took over the product catalog from the Cinder team. [decision; valid 2025-12-19 to now; recorded by handover/2025-12-19-catalog]
- Boreal noticed the ledger service's memory growth and pinged the owners on 2025-02-21. [valid 2025-02-21 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-02-21-2]
